blocks.text: The Sandiganbayan Third Division denied the prosecution’s motion seeking the inhibition of Associate Justice Ronald Moreno in the malversation case of former Sen. Ramon “Bong” Revilla Jr. over the P92.8 million alleged ghost flood control project in Pandi, Bulacan.
